content.thinking: The monthly-spend-feature flag was toggled from off to on at 23:35, with no deploys involved and the process start time staying the same, which points to this flag flip as the likely trigger.

hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: The feature flag `monthly-spend-feature` was rolled from off to on at 23:35 (50/150 split that minute, fully on from 23:36), exposing a latent ZeroDivisionError in src/io_shop/spend_summary.py:35 on the account page. Error rate jumped from ~1% baseline to 17.5% at 23:35 and ~30% thereafter, with no deployment or config change in the preceding week.

supporting_evidence.claim: 2026-09-22T23:35:00Z ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero at src/io_shop/spend_summary.py:35
Every recorded change to io-shop from 2026-09-15T00:00:00Z to 2026-09-22T23:36:00Z: (nothing changed in this window)

hypotheses.summary: Alternative reading: the defective divide in spend_summary.py shipped in code, so the underlying fault is a code defect and a rollback of that module would also stop the errors. The evidence does not support it well — no deployment was recorded in the eight days before onset and process_start_time_seconds is constant across the whole metric span, so no new code was released at onset.
